name: In Memoriam
source:
The crew aboard the Hermes 5 wake up after an indeterminable amount of time in cryostasis, with no recollection of what led them there and other gaps in their memory.

They work together to bring Hermes fully back online and uncover answers to the questions of where they are, how they got there and the strangeness surrounding every detail.

[From [url=https://themeekest.itch.io/in-memoriam]Itch.io[/url]]
